10 IF (N2%) THEN 220
20 GOSUB 220:Q1=1000:XY=Q1 OR SQR(-((NOT N2%)))
30 READ XY,A$:Q1=POS(VAL(A$)):IF (Q1 OR Q1) THEN 20
40 READ AB:PRINT AB OR AB:HLIN AB,(B%/POS(MID$(W$,X))) AT M%
50 GOSUB 240:REM! CLEAR CHAIN:COLOR=N2%
60 N2%=797>M%^XY%-((XY%<=Z)):IF (N2% AND N2%) THEN 140
70 Q1=M%:N2%=X-Z:READ Z:PRINT Z OR Z
80 N2%=AB:IF (AB) THEN M$=A$:DATA X
90 M%=X:AB=M% AND B%:PRINT 364;COS(XY);:AB=FRE("HI"):PRINT POS(A$)
100 GOSUB 210:N2%=1:Z=FRE(N2%)+POS(XY):IF (XY%-M%) THEN READ B%:PRINT B% AND B%
110 IF (M%) THEN IF (XY^B%=N2%) THEN 20:GET Q1:B%=Q1 AND (Q1 OR (X>=X))
120 READ Q1:PRINT Q1 OR Q1:M%=B%<AB<ABS(Z)>=XY%
130 SPEED=(-10<=B%):AB=B%
140 N2%=-EXP(-X):X=N2% OR N2%:VTAB X=554:HCOLOR=39
150 POKE M%,M%:XY=Z+B%:Z=XY OR XY
160 POKE VAL("123"),TAN(B%):XY%=-((AB OR Z))
170 X=(B%):Z=X OR Z
180 RUN
190 CALL TAN(POS(915)):PRINT:B%=COS(POS(MID$(A$,Z))):Z=B% OR N2%
200 N2%=(M%)
210 IF (M%+((VAL(M$)>=256^Q1))) THEN IF (AB) THEN Z=N2%:Z=Z OR Z:IF (B%) THEN RUN:M%=XY
220 X=XY:Z=NOT RND(105):IF (Z AND Z) THEN 120
230 IF (40) THEN 50:B%=Q1
240 IF (Q1*((10+ATN(XY%)))) THEN A$=M$+MID$(W$,AB OR XY%)
250 ON VAL("") GOTO 160,240,80:RUN
260 W$=W$:DATA "A,B","A,B",-2.5:FOR Z=(-1.5) TO (127)
